title: Shirecraft
description:
26.2 paper server with datapacks and some paid/free plugins and custom textures.
Join the discord server to self-whitelist.
body:
[![shirecraft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7ba474c2d591cfd0fb869bfa08b57ea8b0e03c6b.png)](https://discord.gg/mpThbx67J7)  

_Lightweight_ vanilla 26.2 server (paper) with some custom stuff. We largely use paid plugins like [compressy](https://builtbybit.com/resources/compressy.114802/), [**Infinite Fishing**](https://builtbybit.com/resources/infinitefishing-custom-fishing-games.59275), [**Lands**](https://wiki.incredibleplugins.com/lands), [offerings](https://builtbybit.com/resources/offerings.115060/), along with some common plugins deemed "must-haves". In addition to plugins, there are a dozen or so datapacks in use such as faster paths, desire lines, geophilic, explorify, furnicraft, crop and kettle, graves, and more! 

Lands is a full land‑claim, protection, and nation‑building system designed for modern survival servers. It replaces the old “gold shovel” style plugins with a polished, GUI‑driven, MMO‑style territory system that gives players real control over their builds, communities, taxes, and wars.

Infinite Fishing completely overhauls fishing in Minecraft with custom mini-games, loot, and fishing rods! All vanilla loot tables are retained on Shirecraft and we have a custom plugin to enable crafting the rods properly as Infinite Fishing does not provide this feature. 

Finally, with Offerings and Shirecraft Menus plugins, you get your own player hub GUI for quick action access!

![shirecraftmenus hub gui](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5d61025c8c1f53ca3d713426d2c90368902908e5.png)

## Modding

### Known Issues

Do not use mods that present recipes to the player such as, but not limited to, Roughly Enough Items and Just Enough Items. They will do not use the same recipe API as vanilla Minecraft and will result in player disconnects on dynamic recipes.

### Recommended modpack

- [Fabulously Optimized for 26.2](https://modrinth.com/modpack/fabulously-optimized/versions)
